schema_source: REA Live DOM & Accessibility Tree Dissection of PandaDoc Kolas Editor
core_finding: PandaDoc does NOT use a single monolithic contentEditable for the document. Every heading, text block, table cell, and fillable field is an isolated [textbox] slot instance mounted inside a structural layout container.

page_container.header_slot: Document's header toggle area (Double click to edit header)
page_container.footer_slot: Document's footer toggle area (Double click to edit footer)
page_container.pagination_marker: Estimated automatic page break on PDF

observed_block_and_slot_types.variable_chip_isolation: Zero-width space (\u200b) delimiters around inline variable tokens ([Sender.Company], [Client.FirstName], [Client.LastName])

observed_block_and_slot_types.cell_isolation: Each individual <th> (columnheader) and <td> (cell) mounts its own independent [textbox] editor instance inside the cell.
